q: If the MLC conjecture (Mandelbrot set is locally connected) were proved, it would imply:
opts: Every Julia set is locally connected
The Mandelbrot set has a topological model as a quotient of the circle, with every parameter identifiable by its external angles
The Mandelbrot set has Hausdorff dimension 2
exp: MLC implies: the Carathéodory loop (boundary of M parameterised by external angle) gives a continuous surjection S¹→∂M, providing a complete combinatorial description. Every Misiurewicz point and hyperbolic component is identified by its rational external angles.
